tasks.name: Frontend UI
tasks.description: Develop the user interface for the note-taking app, including a text input field and a save button.

tasks.name: Backend API
tasks.description: Implement the backend logic to handle saving and retrieving notes via API endpoints.

tasks.name: Database Models
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema and models to store notes.

tasks.name: Testing
tasks.description: Write and execute tests for the frontend, backend, and database to ensure functionality and reliability.

tasks.name: Deployment Configuration
tasks.description: Set up deployment configurations to host the application on a server or cloud platform.

T1.implementation_approach: Design and develop the frontend using a modern framework like React or Angular, ensuring responsiveness and user-friendly interfaces.
T1.notes: Focus on reusable components and accessibility standards.

T2.implementation_approach: Build RESTful APIs using a backend framework like Express.js or Django, ensuring proper routing and middleware integration.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and validation for secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Define database schemas and models using an ORM like Sequelize or Mongoose, ensuring relationships and constraints are properly set.
T3.notes: Optimize for scalability and future data requirements.

T4.implementation_approach: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest or Cypress to ensure code reliability.
T4.notes: Automate testing in CI/CD pipelines for consistent quality checks.

T5.implementation_approach: Configure deployment pipelines using tools like Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud services like AWS or Azure for scalable and reliable deployment.
T5.notes: Ensure environment variables and secrets are securely managed.
